newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - SEIMAS APPROVES ENERGY DECENTRALIZATION LAW.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - SEIMAS APPROVES ENERGY DECENTRALIZATION LAW.

text.p: Lithuania's Seimas, or parliament, on Tuesday overwhelmingly approved a key law to decentralize the huge Lithuanian Energy company.
Seventy-three deputies voted in favour of the law, which will transfer responsibilities for heating from the central government to the municipalities.
Eight deputies abstained from voting and none opposed the law.

The law says that the decentralization process will be done in stages. The Economy Ministry has until July 1 to make the final decisions regarding the procedures and time table for the transfer of responsibilities.
The law is regarded as a key plank in the government's efforts to reform the country's bloated and inefficient energy sector.
Most of the country's energy enterprises are caught in a vicious cycle of debt, with consumers failing to pay producers, who in turn cannot pay suppliers.
